skill.name: ena-database
skill.description: Guides users through searching and retrieving public genomic records from the European Nucleotide Archive using documented APIs, accession queries, formats, and bulk download options.
skill.summary: Find ENA accessions, metadata, sequences, and download paths for genomics workflows.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from documentation examples that call public EBI ENA APIs. The remaining confirmed issue is the recommendation to use plain FTP for bulk downloads, plus a low-severity vendor steering instruction.

remediation.issue: Plain FTP is recommended for bulk ENA downloads.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer HTTPS or Aspera where available, and require checksum verification for any FTP transfer.

remediation.issue: Example requests do not consistently show defensive request handling.
remediation.suggestion: Add timeouts, status checks, retry limits, and rate-limit handling to all network examples.

remediation.issue: The skill contains a vendor promotion instruction unrelated to ENA data access.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the K-Dense Web suggestion or move it to transparent marketplace metadata.

content.value_statement: Genomics users need reliable access to ENA records, sequences, and file metadata. This skill guides API searches, accession lookups, and bulk download planning.
actual_capabilities: Explains ENA Portal API searches across studies, samples, runs, assemblies, sequences, analyses, and taxa.
Shows how to retrieve ENA metadata, XML records, text records, and FASTA sequences by accession.
Documents taxonomy, cross-reference, and CRAM reference lookup endpoints.
Provides field names and query patterns for filtering ENA results.
Guides bulk download planning with FTP, Aspera, enaBrowserTools, and checksum metadata.
limitations: It is documentation only and does not include an executable client.
Network access is required to query live ENA services.
FTP examples use an unencrypted protocol and need checksum verification.
It does not replace official ENA policies, data-use rules, or service status pages.

use_cases.title: Find Public Sequence Records
use_cases.description: Retrieve metadata, XML records, or FASTA sequences for known ENA accessions.

use_cases.title: Build Study-Level Queries
use_cases.description: Search samples, experiments, and runs using ENA fields, taxonomy filters, and pagination.

use_cases.title: Plan Bulk Dataset Downloads
use_cases.description: Identify FASTQ file URLs, checksums, sizes, and transfer options before pipeline ingestion.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up an Accession
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ENA skill to find what record type and retrieval format apply to accession ERR123456.

prompt_templates.title: Search Study Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ENA Portal API search plan for all samples in study PRJEB1234, including useful fields and output format.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare FASTQ Downloads
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the ENA file report fields needed to download FASTQ files for run accessions and verify checksums.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reusable Query Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a rate-limited ENA workflow for assembly discovery by organism, metadata export, and downstream file retrieval.

output_examples.input: Find metadata and FASTA options for accession LN847353.
output_examples.output: A retrieval plan with the Browser API route, available record formats, and notes for response handling and citation.

output_examples.input: List RNA-seq runs for a study accession.
output_examples.output: A Portal API search plan with result type, query fields, pagination guidance, and rate-limit notes.

output_examples.input: Download FASTQ files for many ENA runs.
output_examples.output: A bulk download workflow with file report fields, transfer options, checksum verification, and retry guidance.

best_practices: Use precise result types and fields to reduce response size.
Respect ENA rate limits and retry only with bounded backoff.
Verify downloaded files with published checksums before analysis.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad queries without limits or pagination.
Do not trust FTP downloads without checksum verification.
Do not parse XML or TSV responses with fragile string matching.

faq.question: Does this skill download data itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, endpoint references, and workflow patterns for ENA access.

faq.question: Which ENA APIs does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Portal, Browser, Taxonomy, Cross-Reference, and CRAM reference services.

faq.question: Can it help with FASTQ files?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains file reports, FASTQ fields, checksums, and bulk download options.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Claude Code, and Codex workflows that need ENA reference guidance.

faq.question: Does it handle private or controlled-access data?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on public ENA endpoints and does not manage credentials or access approvals.

faq.question: What should users verify before analysis?
faq.answer: Users should verify accession scope, data-use requirements, file checksums, and ENA service limits.
